curated-boska-gf-red-hat-text: Stone-cut drama, then a friendly hand. Boska swings hard between fat and hairline strokes, while Red Hat Text follows one steady line you could trace with a finger.
curated-dafont-pixel-operator-work-sans: Terminal blocks with a retro grin. Pixel Operator keeps every letter in its own fixed box, and Work Sans loosens things with open, unpinched curves, fine for, say, settings toggles.
curated-gf-allura-gf-della-respira: Della Respira speaks first, with tall capitals. Allura's slim, pen-traced script gives it a soft, handmade counterpoint, the sort of thing a cute bakery branding job might borrow.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Scribbled, relaxed, a bit crayon-rough. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its place in big, brief display lines, while Tsukimi Rounded supplies tidy round forms beside it.
curated-gf-jersey-10-charted-gf-noto-nas: Jersey 10 Charted comes in bold and tightly packed. Noto Nastaliq Urdu runs dignified and compact beneath it, with a gentle stress in its rounds that rewards a slow read.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose pen strokes, nearly joined. Kapakana is best at casual, closed-up flourish, whereas Spectral SC does its finest work with sturdy hairlines and wide, open rounds.
